sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: In the `withinIceStrengthenedArea = true` branch of both `gen:LongitudinalFrameRequirementShape` and `gen:TransverseFrameRequirementShape`, add `sh:node gen:ApplicableFrameShape`. The specialized targets currently enforce only their subtype-specific attachment rule and can omit the general all-frame obligations—effective reciprocal attachment, exact two-side connection when passing through a support, and installed-bracket thickness/stiffening—when subtype instances are not also selected by `sh:targetClass nltl:frame`. sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the invented `?attachment a nltl:frameEnd` condition from both supporting-structure SPARQL constraints. The attachment is reached through `nltl:hasFrameAttachment` and is the authoritative owner of `nltl:hasAttachedSupportingStructure` and `nltl:effectiveAttachmentConfirmed`; requiring it to be a frame end checks the wrong entity type and causes otherwise valid attachment records to fail. Also explicitly constrain bracket and support objects to the supplied `nltl:connectionBracket` and `nltl:supportingStructure` roles, and incorporate the declared frame-owned `nltl:frameAttachment` relationship according to its supplied object-property role rather than substituting `nltl:frameEnd`.

Replace the `webPlateConnectionSideCount >= 2` logic with an exact conditional value of 2 when `passesThroughSupportingStructure` is true. Encode the exact regulatory count using equal inclusive bounds (`sh:minInclusive 2` and `sh:maxInclusive 2`, with `sh:minCount 1`) so values above 2 cannot pass. Preserve the prior corrections: do not reintroduce `frameEnd`, retain the authoritative attachment owners and typed support/bracket objects, and retain the frame-owned `frameAttachment` relationship.

The `nltl:frameAttachment` relationship is currently semantically vacuous: its class constraint has no minimum cardinality and it is disconnected from the `nltl:hasFrameAttachment` nodes used for all effective-attachment, bracket, and reciprocal-support checks. Integrate the two frame-owned attachment paths so the same attachment nodes used by those checks are also reached through `nltl:frameAttachment`, for example by adding `sh:equals nltl:frameAttachment` to the `nltl:hasFrameAttachment` property shape while retaining the `nltl:frameAttachmentRecord` class constraint. This preserves vacuous truth when no supporting structure exists but prevents the declared relationship from being an unused approximation. Preserve the prior corrections: do not reintroduce `frameEnd`, retain authoritative attachment ownership and typed support/bracket objects, and retain the exact conditional side count of 2 using equal inclusive bounds.
